en: Revenue rose 138% to a record $1.24B, about 15% above the ~$1.07B consensus, as product revenue topped $1B for the first time. Non-GAAP gross margin was 34.5% and operating income $286M, more than all of 2025; adjusted EPS of $0.94 beat ~$0.69. Bloom raised 2026 guidance a third time, to $4.4–4.6B with EPS of $3.10–3.40. CEO KR Sridhar said grid limits keep pushing data centers to on-site power and capacity nears 5 GW a year; CFO Simon Edwards held margin guidance at ~34% on ramp and expediting costs.

Shares fell 8.7% to $217.77 on report day as AI power and chip names sold off, then about 6% more after hours despite the beat. In the first session they closed down 11.2% at $193.30, about 44% below the recent high, as investors focused on −$181M free cash flow (expected positive), negative operating cash flow and tripled capex. JPMorgan and Roth cut targets, while Morgan Stanley raised its target; the CFO called the cash use timing, not a trend.
zh: 营收增长 138% 至创纪录的 12.4 亿美元，比约 10.7 亿美元的一致预期高约 15%，产品收入首次突破 10 亿美元。非GAAP毛利率 34.5%，营业利润 2.86 亿美元，超过 2025 年全年；经调整每股收益 0.94 美元，高于约 0.69 美元的预期。Bloom 第三次上调 2026 年指引，营收至 44–46 亿美元、每股收益 3.10–3.40 美元。CEO K.R. 斯里达尔表示，电网瓶颈持续推动数据中心转向现场发电，年产能接近 5 吉瓦；CFO 西蒙·爱德华兹因扩产和加急交付成本，维持约 34% 的毛利率指引。
财报当天，AI 电力与芯片股遭抛售，股价下跌 8.7% 至 217.77 美元；尽管业绩超预期，盘后再跌约 6%。首个交易日收跌 11.2% 至 193.30 美元，较近期高点低约 44%，投资者聚焦于 −1.81 亿美元的自由现金流（市场原预期为正）、为负的经营现金流以及增至三倍的资本开支。摩根大通和 Roth 下调目标价，摩根士丹利则上调目标价；CFO 称现金流出属时间性因素，并非趋势。

bio.en: Founded Bloom (originally Ion America) in 2001 after leading a University of Arizona lab that built an oxygen-generating fuel-cell system for NASA's Mars program. Chairman and CEO since, now positioning Bloom as fast on-site power for AI data centers.
bio.zh: 2001 年创立 Bloom（原名 Ion America），此前在亚利桑那大学领导实验室，为 NASA 火星计划研制制氧燃料电池系统。此后一直任董事长兼 CEO，现将 Bloom 定位为 AI 数据中心的快速现场供电方案。

bio.en: Joined in 2026 from AI-chip startup Groq, where he was CFO and later CEO after its licensing deal with NVIDIA. Earlier held CFO roles at other technology companies; Wharton MBA.
bio.zh: 2026 年从 AI 芯片初创公司 Groq 加入；他曾任 Groq CFO，在其与英伟达达成授权交易后出任 CEO。此前在其他科技公司担任 CFO；沃顿商学院 MBA。

sources.t: First-session move: cash flow concerns (Motley Fool)
